text:
lia: Quick heads-up — quant8x4 run on qx6b showed tokenization drift for non-latin (zh/ja). BLEU down but logits ok; looks like chunk boundary change.

diego: saw similar before with chinese longforms. repro available?

lia: yes, two near-duplicate cn prompts diverge by 2 tokens after compile. suspect byte-chunking fallback.

nina: our harness buckets lang but not tokenization stability. propose a stability cohort comparing token_id sequences pre/post compile.

tess: also create multilingual golden with orig/normalized/decomp pairs to isolate normalization vs quant.

lia: plan: 1) sample 1k across en,es,fr,zh,ja,ko from long/medium tails; 2) store token_id seqs pre/post in separate .tok files; 3) compute token_stability metric; 4) label adequacy/fluency and flag markup-normalization and PII.

label-bot: Tasks queued: mg-gold-3950-1 (200 zh/ja), mg-gold-3950-2 (200 en/es/fr), mg-gold-3950-3 (200 ko/others), mg-gold-3950-4 (400 reserve). Checklist added.

yk: prefer newline token ids per file and a csv map row->path. ok?

lia: yes. mapping s3://curation/multigold/3950001111/mappings.csv. access eng-ml + test-infra.

diego: harness snippet to compute stability: def token_stability(b,a): diffs=sum(1 for x,y in zip(b,a) if x!=y)+abs(len(b)-len(a)); return diffs/max(len(b),1)

nina: once we have scores, flag examples >0.1 instability in quant regression report and weight accordingly.

tess: labeling owners: tess/nina split langs, diego owns harness patch, lia curates sample. label-bot schedule review shifts.

label-bot: 4 reviewer slots scheduled tomorrow 14:00 PST. Assigned: tess, nina, lia, diego.

yk: note: html entities can collapse on normalization causing token shifts; add html-unescape step and label "markup-normalization" when observed.

diego: i'll PR the harness changes and attach lang breakdown artifacts. ETA EOD.

lia: after label bursts we'll run a canary compare quant8x4 vs float32 on the 1k set and break down regressions by stability/markup/len-bucket. export subset where stability==0 but quality dropped for focused review.

label-bot: All tasks updated with s3 links and checklist.
